description: This Java class implements a log filter named MessageOnlyLogFilter, which filters log output to only display messages by removing metadata and other log details. It has methods to chain log nodes for further processing.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that passes only log messages downstream.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Implements LogNode's println method; forwards only the message part to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
